title: Simplified CRM Dashboard for Small Teams
description: A lightweight, customizable CRM dashboard that integrates with GitHub and Slack, offering a clean interface for managing sales pipelines and team communication.
audience: Small teams and startups looking for a simple, affordable CRM solution that integrates with their existing tools without the complexity of Salesforce.
pitch: A modern, open-source CRM dashboard with optional paid support, designed for small teams that need to manage sales pipelines and team communication without the overhead of complex platforms.

market_validation.reason: Low-cost original pilot answering a real first-person user problem, with market validation still to be measured. No verified demand or revenue is claimed.
